methodologyNotes: Covers aftermarket automotive loudspeakers sold at a published US MSRP: coaxial (full-range) and separate component sets designed to replace factory door/dash speakers. Excludes subwoofers, tweeter-only kits, marine/powersports drivers, and OEM-fit modules. Price is typical MSRP per pair in USD. speakerType is an enum: coaxial or component. configuration is the driver layout as an enum (2-way, 3-way, 4-way). sizeInches is the nominal mounting size in inches, given as a single number (e.g. 6.5) or as WxH for oval woofers (e.g. 6x9). powerRmsWatts is continuous/RMS power handling per speaker in watts. powerPeakWatts is max/peak power handling per speaker in watts. sensitivityDb is rated sensitivity in dB (2.83V/1m or 1W/1m as published); higher is louder for a given input. impedanceOhms is nominal impedance in ohms. frequencyResponseHz is the published low-to-high range in Hz (e.g. 55-30000). mountingDepthIn is top-mount/cut-out depth in inches. wooferMaterial is the cone material as published (enum-like text, e.g. polypropylene, flax, glass-fiber). tweeterMaterial is the tweeter dome/diaphragm material as published (e.g. silk, aluminum, PEI). crossoverIncluded is a boolean: true if external passive crossovers ship in the box (typical for component sets). Null where a manufacturer does not disclose a value.
